blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Alyssa Solomon is moving to Thailand as part of champion team Nakhon Ratchasima 3M Films VC ahead of the next Thailand League season. The former National University star was part of the roster unveiling on Saturday. Her latest stint for an international club comes after suiting up for Alas Pilipinas in the Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya. Solomon will be the fourth Filipino import to play for Nakhon Ratchasima after Mylene Paat and Dindin Santiago-Manabat and Ced Domingo.
